const VM = "America/Bogota";
function ooe(e) {
    if (e instanceof Date)
        return e;
    const t = String(e).trim();
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(t)) {
        const [n,a,s] = t.split("-").map(Number);
        return new Date(n,a - 1,s)
    }
    const r = t.replace(/\.(\d{3})\d+$/, ".$1").replace(/Z$/, "");
    return new Date(`${r}Z`)
}
function yd(e) {
    return e ? ooe(e).toLocaleDateString("es-CO", {
        timeZone: VM,
        day: "2-digit",
        month: "long",
        year: "numeric"
    }) : ""
}
function Nh(e) {
    return e ? ooe(e).toLocaleString("es-CO", {
        timeZone: VM,

function WFe(e, t) {
    const r = (e.toString().split(".")[1] || "").length
      , n = (t.toString().split(".")[1] || "").length
      , a = r > n ? r : n
      , s = Number.parseInt(e.toFixed(a).replace(".", ""))
      , i = Number.parseInt(t.toFixed(a).replace(".", ""));
    return s % i / 10 ** a
}

class Eg extends oi {
    _parse(t) {
        const {ctx: r, status: n} = this._processInputParams(t)
          , a = this._def;
        if (r.parsedType !== sa.array)
            return Un(r, {
                code: un.invalid_type,
                expected: sa.array,
                received: r.parsedType
            }),
            Ga;
        if (a.exactLength !== null) {
            const i = r.data.length > a.exactLength.value
              , l = r.data.length < a.exactLength.value;
            (i || l) && (Un(r, {
                code: i ? un.too_big : un.too_small,
                minimum: l ? a.exactLength.value : void 0,
                maximum: i ? a.exactLength.value : void 0,
                type: "array",
                inclusive: !0,
                exact: !0,
                message: a.exactLength.message
            }),
            n.dirty())
        }
        if (a.minLength !== null && r.data.length < a.minLength.value && (Un(r, {
            code: un.too_small,
            minimum: a.minLength.value,
            type: "array",
            inclusive: !0,
            exact: !1,
            message: a.minLength.message
        }),
        n.dirty()),
        a.maxLength !== null && r.data.length > a.maxLength.value && (Un(r, {
            code: un.too_big,
            maximum: a.maxLength.value,
            type: "array",
            inclusive: !0,
            exact: !1,
            message: a.maxLength.message
        }),
        n.dirty()),
        r.common.async)
            return Promise.all([...r.data].map( (i, l) => a.type._parseAsync(new Y1(r,i,r.path,l)))).then(i => hf.mergeArray(n, i));
        const s = [...r.data].map( (i, l) => a.type._parseSync(new Y1(r,i,r.path,l)));
        return hf.mergeArray(n, s)
    }
    get element() {
        return this._def.type
    }
    min(t, r) {
        return new Eg({
            ...this._def,
            minLength: {
                value: t,
                message: xa.toString(r)
            }
        })
    }
    max(t, r) {
        return new Eg({
            ...this._def,
            maxLength: {
                value: t,
                message: xa.toString(r)
            }
        })
    }
    length(t, r) {
        return new Eg({
            ...this._def,
            exactLength: {
                value: t,
                message: xa.toString(r)
            }
        })

    }

                            value: u

                            value: a.data[u]
                        }
                    });

                    keys: l

            t && !t[n] ? r[n] = a : r[n] = a.optional()
        }

        })
    }

function TL(e, t) {
    const r = Rv(e)
      , n = Rv(t);
    if (e === t)
        return {
            valid: !0,
            data: e
        };
    if (r === sa.object && n === sa.object) {
        const a = io.objectKeys(t)
          , s = io.objectKeys(e).filter(l => a.indexOf(l) !== -1)
          , i = {
            ...e,
            ...t
        };
        for (const l of s) {
            const c = TL(e[l], t[l]);
            if (!c.valid)
                return {
                    valid: !1
                };
            i[l] = c.data
        }
        return {
            valid: !0,
            data: i
        }
    } else if (r === sa.array && n === sa.array) {
        if (e.length !== t.length)
            return {
                valid: !1
            };
        const a = [];
        for (let s = 0; s < e.length; s++) {
            const i = e[s]
              , l = t[s]
              , c = TL(i, l);
            if (!c.valid)
                return {
                    valid: !1
                };
            a.push(c.data)
        }
        return {
            valid: !0,
            data: a
        }
    } else
        return r === sa.date && n === sa.date && +e == +t ? {
            valid: !0,
            data: e
        } : {
            valid: !1
        }
}

        this
    }

        return !this.littleEndian
    }

        return this.littleEndian = !1,
        this
    }

        return this.offset += t,
        this
    }

        return this.offset -= t,
        this
    }

        return this.offset = t,
        this

        return this._mark = this.offset,
        this
    }

        return this.offset = this._mark,
        this
    }

        return this._marks.push(this.offset),
        this
    }
    popMark() {
        const t = this._marks.pop();
        if (t === void 0)
            throw new Error("Mark stack empty");
        return this.seek(t),
        this
    }
    rewind() {
        return this.offset = 0,
        this
    }
    ensureAvailable(t=1) {
        if (!this.available(t)) {
            const n = (this.offset + t) * 2
              , a = new Uint8Array(n);
            a.set(new Uint8Array(this.buffer)),
            this.buffer = a.buffer,
            this.length = n,
            this.byteLength = n,
            this._data = new DataView(this.buffer)
        }
        return this
    }

        return this.readUint8() !== 0
    }

        return this._data.getInt8(this.offset++)
    }
    readUint8() {
        return this._data.getUint8(this.offset++)

        return this.readUint8()

        i

    toArray() {
        return new Uint8Array(this.buffer,this.byteOffset,this.lastWrittenByte)
    }
    getWrittenByteLength() {
        return this.lastWrittenByte - this.byteOffset
    }

        this.offset > this.lastWrittenByte && (this.lastWrittenByte = this.offset)

class UAe {
    decode(t, r, n) {
        return this.predefinedOps[n[0]] ? this.predefinedOps[n[0]] : this.type.decode(t, r, n)
    }
    size(t, r) {
        return this.type.size(t, r)
    }
    encode(t, r, n) {
        let a = this.predefinedOps.indexOf(r);
        return a !== -1 ? a : this.type.encode(t, r, n)
    }
    constructor(t, r) {
        this.predefinedOps = t,
        this.type = r
    }
}

var VAe = EHe;
class pz {
    static decode(t) {
        return new pz(t)
    }
    decode() {
        this.stream.pos;
        let t = VAe.decode(this.stream);
        for (let r in t) {
            let n = t[r];
            this[r] = n
        }
        if (this.version < 2) {
            if (this.topDictIndex.length !== 1)
                throw new Error("Only a single font is allowed in CFF");
            this.topDict = this.topDictIndex[0]
        }
        return this.isCIDFont = this.topDict.ROS != null,
        this
    }
    string(t) {
        return this.version >= 2 ? null : t < I8.length ? I8[t] : this.stringIndex[t - I8.length]
    }
    get postscriptName() {
        return this.version < 2 ? this.nameIndex[0] : null
    }
    get fullName() {
        return this.string(this.topDict.FullName)
    }
    get familyName() {
        return this.string(this.topDict.FamilyName)
    }
    getCharString(t) {
        return this.stream.pos = this.topDict.CharStrings[t].offset,
        this.stream.readBuffer(this.topDict.CharStrings[t].length)
    }
    getGlyphName(t) {
        if (this.version >= 2 || this.isCIDFont)
            return null;
        let {charset: r} = this.topDict;
        if (Array.isArray(r))
            return r[t];
        if (t === 0)
            return ".notdef";
        switch (t -= 1,
        r.version) {
        case 0:
            return this.string(r.glyphs[t]);
        case 1:
        case 2:
            for (let n = 0; n < r.ranges.length; n++) {
                let a = r.ranges[n];
                if (a.offset <= t && t <= a.offset + a.nLeft)
                    return this.string(a.first + (t - a.offset))
            }
            break
        }
        return null
    }
    fdForGlyph(t) {
        if (!this.topDict.FDSelect)
            return null;
        switch (this.topDict.FDSelect.version) {
        case 0:
            return this.topDict.FDSelect.fds[t];
        case 3:
        case 4:
            let {ranges: r} = this.topDict.FDSelect
              , n = 0
              , a = r.length - 1;
            for (; n <= a; ) {
                let s = n + a >> 1;
                if (t < r[s].first)
                    a = s - 1;
                else if (s < a && t >= r[s + 1].first)
                    n = s + 1;
                else
                    return r[s].fd
            }
        default:
            throw new Error(`Unknown FDSelect version: ${this.topDict.FDSelect.version}`)
        }
    }
    privateDictForGlyph(t) {
        if (this.topDict.FDSelect) {
            let r = this.fdForGlyph(t);
            return this.topDict.FDArray[r] ? this.topDict.FDArray[r].Private : null
        }
        return this.version < 2 ? this.topDict.Private : this.topDict.FDArray[0].Private
    }
    constructor(t) {
        this.stream = t,
        this.decode()
    }
}

class z4 {
    buildStruct(t) {
        let r = t;
        for (; !r[this.key] && r.parent; )
            r = r.parent;
        if (!r[this.key])
            return;
        let n = {};
        n.rel = () => r._startOffset;
        let a = r[this.key];
        for (let s in a)
            a[s] && (n[s] = $He[s]);
        return new lr(n)
    }
    size(t, r) {
        return this.buildStruct(r).size(t, r)
    }
    decode(t, r) {
        let n = this.buildStruct(r).decode(t, r);
        return delete n.rel,
        n
    }
    constructor(t="valueFormat") {
        this.key = t
    }
}

class Gze {
    getItem(t) {
        if (this._items[t] == null) {
            let r = this.stream.pos;
            this.stream.pos = this.base + this.type.size(null, this.parent) * t,
            this._items[t] = this.type.decode(this.stream, this.parent),
            this.stream.pos = r
        }
        return this._items[t]
    }
    inspect() {
        return `[UnboundedArray ${this.type.constructor.name}]`
    }
    constructor(t, r, n) {
        this.type = t,
        this.stream = r,
        this.parent = n,
        this.base = this.stream.pos,
        this._items = []
    }
}

function B8(e, t) {
    let r = 0
      , n = e.length - 1;
    for (; r <= n; ) {
        let a = r + n >> 1
          , s = t(e[a]);
        if (s < 0)
            n = a - 1;
        else if (s > 0)
            r = a + 1;
        else
            return a
    }
    return -1
}
function cC(e, t) {
    let r = [];
    for (; e < t; )
        r.push(e++);
    return r
}

function vz(e) {
    let t = e.length * .75;
    e[e.length - 1] === "=" && (t--,
    e[e.length - 2] === "=" && t--);
    let r = new Uint8Array(t)
      , n = 0;
    for (let a = 0, s = e.length; a < s; a += 4) {
        let i = QI[e.charCodeAt(a)]
          , l = QI[e.charCodeAt(a + 1)]
          , c = QI[e.charCodeAt(a + 2)]
          , d = QI[e.charCodeAt(a + 3)];
        r[n++] = i << 2 | l >> 4,
        r[n++] = (l & 15) << 4 | c >> 2,
        r[n++] = (c & 3) << 6 | d & 63
    }
    return r
}
class xz {
    findSubtable(t, r) {
        for (let[n,a] of r)
            for (let s of t.tables)
                if (s.platformID === n && s.encodingID === a)
                    return s.table;
        return null
    }
    lookup(t, r) {
        if (this.encoding)
            t = this.encoding.get(t) || t;
        else if (r) {
            let a = this.getVariationSelector(t, r);
            if (a)
                return a
        }
        let n = this.cmap;
        switch (n.version) {
        case 0:
            return n.codeMap.get(t) || 0;
        case 4:
            {
                let a = 0
                  , s = n.segCount - 1;
                for (; a <= s; ) {
                    let i = a + s >> 1;
                    if (t < n.startCode.get(i))
                        s = i - 1;
                    else if (t > n.endCode.get(i))
                        a = i + 1;
                    else {
                        let l = n.idRangeOffset.get(i), c;
                        if (l === 0)
                            c = t + n.idDelta.get(i);
                        else {
                            let d = l / 2 + (t - n.startCode.get(i)) - (n.segCount - i);
                            c = n.glyphIndexArray.get(d) || 0,
                            c !== 0 && (c += n.idDelta.get(i))
                        }
                        return c & 65535
                    }
                }
                return 0
            }
        case 8:
            throw new Error("TODO: cmap format 8");
        case 6:
        case 10:
            return n.glyphIndices.get(t - n.firstCode) || 0;
        case 12:
        case 13:
            {
                let a = 0
                  , s = n.nGroups - 1;
                for (; a <= s; ) {
                    let i = a + s >> 1
                      , l = n.groups.get(i);
                    if (t < l.startCharCode)
                        s = i - 1;
                    else if (t > l.endCharCode)
                        a = i + 1;
                    else
                        return n.version === 12 ? l.glyphID + (t - l.startCharCode) : l.glyphID
                }
                return 0
            }
        case 14:
            throw new Error("TODO: cmap format 14");
        default:
            throw new Error(`Unknown cmap format ${n.version}`)
        }
    }
    getVariationSelector(t, r) {
        if (!this.uvs)
            return 0;
        let n = this.uvs.varSelectors.toArray()
          , a = B8(n, i => r - i.varSelector)
          , s = n[a];
        return a !== -1 && s.defaultUVS && (a = B8(s.defaultUVS, i => t < i.startUnicodeValue ? -1 : t > i.startUnicodeValue + i.additionalCount ? 1 : 0)),
        a !== -1 && s.nonDefaultUVS && (a = B8(s.nonDefaultUVS, i => t - i.unicodeValue),
        a !== -1) ? s.nonDefaultUVS[a].glyphID : 0
    }
    getCharacterSet() {
        let t = this.cmap;
        switch (t.version) {
        case 0:
            return cC(0, t.codeMap.length);
        case 4:
            {
                let r = []
                  , n = t.endCode.toArray();
                for (let a = 0; a < n.length; a++) {
                    let s = n[a] + 1
                      , i = t.startCode.get(a);
                    r.push(...cC(i, s))
                }
                return r
            }
        case 8:
            throw new Error("TODO: cmap format 8");
        case 6:
        case 10:
            return cC(t.firstCode, t.firstCode + t.glyphIndices.length);
        case 12:
        case 13:
            {
                let r = [];
                for (let n of t.groups.toArray())
                    r.push(...cC(n.startCharCode, n.endCharCode + 1));
                return r
            }
        case 14:
            throw new Error("TODO: cmap format 14");
        default:
            throw new Error(`Unknown cmap format ${t.version}`)
        }
    }
    codePointsForGlyph(t) {
        let r = this.cmap;
        switch (r.version) {
        case 0:
            {
                let a = [];
                for (let s = 0; s < 256; s++)
                    r.codeMap.get(s) === t && a.push(s);
                return a
            }
        case 4:
            {
                let a = [];
                for (let s = 0; s < r.segCount; s++) {
                    let i = r.endCode.get(s)
                      , l = r.startCode.get(s)
                      , c = r.idRangeOffset.get(s)
                      , d = r.idDelta.get(s);
                    for (var n = l; n <= i; n++) {
                        let u = 0;
                        if (c === 0)
                            u = n + d;
                        else {
                            let A = c / 2 + (n - l) - (r.segCount - s);
                            u = r.glyphIndexArray.get(A) || 0,
                            u !== 0 && (u += d)
                        }
                        u === t && a.push(n)
                    }
                }
                return a
            }
        case 12:
            {
                let a = [];
                for (let s of r.groups.toArray())
                    t >= s.glyphID && t <= s.glyphID + (s.endCharCode - s.startCharCode) && a.push(s.startCharCode + (t - s.glyphID));
                return a
            }
        case 13:
            {
                let a = [];
                for (let s of r.groups.toArray())
                    t === s.glyphID && a.push(...cC(s.startCharCode, s.endCharCode + 1));
                return a
            }
        default:
            throw new Error(`Unknown cmap format ${r.version}`)
        }
    }
    constructor(t) {
        if (this.encoding = null,
        this.cmap = this.findSubtable(t, [[3, 10], [0, 6], [0, 4], [3, 1], [0, 3], [0, 2], [0, 1], [0, 0]]),
        !this.cmap)
            for (let r of t.tables) {

                  , a = jMe(n);
                a && (this.cmap = r.table,
                this.encoding = a)
            }
        if (!this.cmap)
            throw new Error("Could not find a supported cmap table");
        this.uvs = this.findSubtable(t, [[0, 5]]),
        this.uvs && this.uvs.version !== 14 && (this.uvs = null)
    }
}

class EGe {
    process(t, r) {
        for (let n = 0; n < t.length - 1; n++) {
            let a = t[n].id
              , s = t[n + 1].id;
            r[n].xAdvance += this.getKerning(a, s)
        }
    }
    getKerning(t, r) {
        let n = 0;
        for (let a of this.kern.tables) {
            if (a.coverage.crossStream)
                continue;
            switch (a.version) {
            case 0:
                if (!a.coverage.horizontal)
                    continue;
                break;
            case 1:
                if (a.coverage.vertical || a.coverage.variation)
                    continue;
                break;
            default:
                throw new Error(`Unsupported kerning table version ${a.version}`)
            }
            let s = 0
              , i = a.subtable;
            switch (a.format) {
            case 0:
                let l = B8(i.pairs, function(A) {
                    return t - A.left || r - A.right
                });
                l >= 0 && (s = i.pairs[l].value);
                break;
            case 2:
                let c = 0
                  , d = 0;
                t >= i.leftTable.firstGlyph && t < i.leftTable.firstGlyph + i.leftTable.nGlyphs ? c = i.leftTable.offsets[t - i.leftTable.firstGlyph] : c = i.array.off,
                r >= i.rightTable.firstGlyph && r < i.rightTable.firstGlyph + i.rightTable.nGlyphs && (d = i.rightTable.offsets[r - i.rightTable.firstGlyph]);
                let u = (c + d - i.array.off) / 2;
                s = i.array.values.get(u);
                break;
            case 3:
                if (t >= i.glyphCount || r >= i.glyphCount)
                    return 0;
                s = i.kernValue[i.kernIndex[i.leftClass[t] * i.rightClassCount + i.rightClass[r]]];
                break;
            default:
                throw new Error(`Unsupported kerning sub-table format ${a.format}`)
            }
            a.coverage.override ? n = s : n += s
        }
        return n
    }
    constructor(t) {
        this.kern = t.kern
    }
}
class IGe {

    }
    positionCluster(t, r, n, a) {
        let s = t[n]
          , i = s.cbox.copy();
        s.codePoints.length > 1 && (i.minX += (s.codePoints.length - 1) * i.width / s.codePoints.length);
        let l = -r[n].xAdvance
          , c = 0
          , d = this.font.unitsPerEm / 16;
        for (let u = n + 1; u <= a; u++) {
            let A = t[u]
              , h = A.cbox
              , f = r[u]
              , p = this.getCombiningClass(A.codePoints[0]);
            if (p !== "Not_Reordered") {
                switch (f.xOffset = f.yOffset = 0,
                p) {
                case "Double_Above":
                case "Double_Below":
                    f.xOffset += i.minX - h.width / 2 - h.minX;
                    break;
                case "Attached_Below_Left":
                case "Below_Left":
                case "Above_Left":
                    f.xOffset += i.minX - h.minX;
                    break;
                case "Attached_Above_Right":
                case "Below_Right":
                case "Above_Right":
                    f.xOffset += i.maxX - h.width - h.minX;
                    break;
                default:
                    f.xOffset += i.minX + (i.width - h.width) / 2 - h.minX
                }
                switch (p) {
                case "Double_Below":
                case "Below_Left":
                case "Below":
                case "Below_Right":
                case "Attached_Below_Left":
                case "Attached_Below":
                    (p === "Attached_Below_Left" || p === "Attached_Below") && (i.minY += d),
                    f.yOffset = -i.minY - h.maxY,
                    i.minY += h.height;
                    break;
                case "Double_Above":
                case "Above_Left":
                case "Above":
                case "Above_Right":
                case "Attached_Above":
                case "Attached_Above_Right":
                    (p === "Attached_Above" || p === "Attached_Above_Right") && (i.maxY += d),
                    f.yOffset = i.maxY - h.minY,
                    i.maxY += h.height;
                    break
                }
                f.xAdvance = f.yAdvance = 0,
                f.xOffset += l,
                f.yOffset += c
            } else
                l -= f.xAdvance,
                c -= f.yAdvance
        }
    }

class Fy {
    get width() {
        return this.maxX - this.minX
    }
    get height() {
        return this.maxY - this.minY
    }
    addPoint(t, r) {
        Math.abs(t) !== 1 / 0 && (t < this.minX && (this.minX = t),
        t > this.maxX && (this.maxX = t)),
        Math.abs(r) !== 1 / 0 && (r < this.minY && (this.minY = r),
        r > this.maxY && (this.maxY = r))
    }
    copy() {
        return new Fy(this.minX,this.minY,this.maxX,this.maxY)
    }
    constructor(t=1 / 0, r=1 / 0, n=-1 / 0, a=-1 / 0) {
        this.minX = t,
        this.minY = r,
        this.maxX = n,
        this.maxY = a
    }

function FJ(e) {
    let[t,r] = e;
    if (isNaN(t))
        var n = Rb[t] && Rb[t].code;
    else
        var n = t;
    if (isNaN(r))
        var a = Rb[t] && Rb[t][r];
    else
        var a = r;
    return [n, a]
}
function RGe(e) {
    let t = {};
    if (Array.isArray(e))
        for (let r = 0; r < e.length; r++) {
            let n, a = FJ(e[r]);
            (n = Db[a[0]] && Db[a[0]][a[1]]) && (t[n] = !0)
        }
    else if (typeof e == "object")
        for (let r in e) {
            let n = e[r];
            for (let a in n) {
                let s, i = FJ([r, a]);
                n[a] && (s = Db[i[0]] && Db[i[0]][i[1]]) && (t[s] = !0)
            }
        }
    return Object.keys(t)
}
class fB {
    lookup(t) {
        switch (this.table.version) {
        case 0:
            return this.table.values.getItem(t);
        case 2:
        case 4:
            {
                let a = 0
                  , s = this.table.binarySearchHeader.nUnits - 1;
                for (; a <= s; ) {
                    var r = a + s >> 1
                      , n = this.table.segments[r];
                    if (n.firstGlyph === 65535)
                        return null;
                    if (t < n.firstGlyph)
                        s = r - 1;
                    else if (t > n.lastGlyph)
                        a = r + 1;
                    else
                        return this.table.version === 2 ? n.value : n.values[t - n.firstGlyph]
                }
                return null
            }
        case 6:
            {
                let a = 0
                  , s = this.table.binarySearchHeader.nUnits - 1;
                for (; a <= s; ) {
                    var r = a + s >> 1
                      , n = this.table.segments[r];
                    if (n.glyph === 65535)
                        return null;
                    if (t < n.glyph)
                        s = r - 1;
                    else if (t > n.glyph)
                        a = r + 1;
                    else
                        return n.value
                }
                return null
            }
        case 8:
            return this.table.values[t - this.table.firstGlyph];
        default:
            throw new Error(`Unknown lookup table format: ${this.table.version}`)
        }
    }
    glyphsForValue(t) {
        let r = [];
        switch (this.table.version) {
        case 2:
        case 4:
            for (let n of this.table.segments)
                if (this.table.version === 2 && n.value === t)
                    r.push(...cC(n.firstGlyph, n.lastGlyph + 1));
                else
                    for (let a = 0; a < n.values.length; a++)
                        n.values[a] === t && r.push(n.firstGlyph + a);
            break;
        case 6:
            for (let n of this.table.segments)
                n.value === t && r.push(n.glyph);
            break;
        case 8:
            for (let n = 0; n < this.table.values.length; n++)
                this.table.values[n] === t && r.push(this.table.firstGlyph + n);
            break;
        default:
            throw new Error(`Unknown lookup table format: ${this.table.version}`)
        }
        return r
    }

                for (let i of s.subTables)
                    if (this.applyLookup(s.lookupType, i))
                        break;
                this.glyphIterator.next()
            }
    }

        throw new Error("applyLookup must be implemented by subclasses")
    }
    applyLookupList(t) {
        let r = this.glyphIterator.options
          , n = this.glyphIterator.index;
        for (let a of t) {
            this.glyphIterator.reset(r, n),
            this.glyphIterator.increment(a.sequenceIndex);
            let s = this.table.lookupList.get(a.lookupListIndex);
            this.glyphIterator.reset(s.flags, this.glyphIterator.index);
            for (let i of s.subTables)
                if (this.applyLookup(s.lookupType, i))
                    break
        }
        return this.glyphIterator.reset(r, n),
        !0
    }
    coverageIndex(t, r) {
        switch (r == null && (r = this.glyphIterator.cur.id),
        t.version) {
        case 1:
            return t.glyphs.indexOf(r);
        case 2:
            for (let n of t.rangeRecords)
                if (n.start <= r && r <= n.end)
                    return n.startCoverageIndex + r - n.start;
            break
        }
        return -1
    }
    match(t, r, n, a) {
        let s = this.glyphIterator.index
          , i = this.glyphIterator.increment(t)
          , l = 0;
        for (; l < r.length && i && n(r[l], i); )
            a && a.push(this.glyphIterator.index),
            l++,
            i = this.glyphIterator.next();
        return this.glyphIterator.index = s,
        l < r.length ? !1 : a || !0
    }
    sequenceMatches(t, r) {
        return this.match(t, r, (n, a) => n === a.id)
    }
    sequenceMatchIndices(t, r) {
        return this.match(t, r, (n, a) => this.currentFeature in a.features ? n === a.id : !1, [])
    }
    coverageSequenceMatches(t, r) {
        return this.match(t, r, (n, a) => this.coverageIndex(n, a.id) >= 0)
    }
    getClassID(t, r) {
        switch (r.version) {
        case 1:
            let n = t - r.startGlyph;
            if (n >= 0 && n < r.classValueArray.length)
                return r.classValueArray[n];
            break;
        case 2:
            for (let a of r.classRangeRecord)
                if (a.start <= t && t <= a.end)
                    return a.class;
            break
        }
        return 0
    }
    classSequenceMatches(t, r, n) {
        return this.match(t, r, (a, s) => a === this.getClassID(s.id, n))
    }
    applyContext(t) {
        let r, n;
        switch (t.version) {
        case 1:
            if (r = this.coverageIndex(t.coverage),
            r === -1)
                return !1;
            n = t.ruleSets[r];
            for (let a of n)
                if (this.sequenceMatches(1, a.input))
                    return this.applyLookupList(a.lookupRecords);
            break;
        case 2:
            if (this.coverageIndex(t.coverage) === -1 || (r = this.getClassID(this.glyphIterator.cur.id, t.classDef),
            r === -1))
                return !1;
            n = t.classSet[r];
            for (let a of n)
                if (this.classSequenceMatches(1, a.classes, t.classDef))
                    return this.applyLookupList(a.lookupRecords);
            break;
        case 3:
            if (this.coverageSequenceMatches(0, t.coverages))
                return this.applyLookupList(t.lookupRecords);
            break
        }
        return !1
    }
    applyChainingContext(t) {
        let r;
        switch (t.version) {
        case 1:
            if (r = this.coverageIndex(t.coverage),
            r === -1)
                return !1;
            let n = t.chainRuleSets[r];
            for (let s of n)
                if (this.sequenceMatches(-s.backtrack.length, s.backtrack) && this.sequenceMatches(1, s.input) && this.sequenceMatches(1 + s.input.length, s.lookahead))
                    return this.applyLookupList(s.lookupRecords);
            break;
        case 2:
            if (this.coverageIndex(t.coverage) === -1)
                return !1;
            r = this.getClassID(this.glyphIterator.cur.id, t.inputClassDef);
            let a = t.chainClassSet[r];
            if (!a)
                return !1;
            for (let s of a)
                if (this.classSequenceMatches(-s.backtrack.length, s.backtrack, t.backtrackClassDef) && this.classSequenceMatches(1, s.input, t.inputClassDef) && this.classSequenceMatches(1 + s.input.length, s.lookahead, t.lookaheadClassDef))
                    return this.applyLookupList(s.lookupRecords);
            break;
        case 3:
            if (this.coverageSequenceMatches(-t.backtrackGlyphCount, t.backtrackCoverage) && this.coverageSequenceMatches(0, t.inputCoverage) && this.coverageSequenceMatches(t.inputGlyphCount, t.lookaheadCoverage))
                return this.applyLookupList(t.lookupRecords);
            break
        }
        return !1
    }

        this.table = r,
        this.script = null,
        this.scriptTag = null,
        this.language = null,
        this.languageTag = null,
        this.features = {},
        this.lookups = {},

        this.selectScript(),
        this.glyphs = [],
        this.positions = [],
        this.ligatureID = 1,
        this.currentFeature = null
    }

    }

function rfe(e, t, r) {
    let n = e[t]
      , s = n.codePoints[0] - V4
      , i = c5 + s % zS;
    s = s / zS | 0;
    let l = G7 + s / fT | 0
      , c = V7 + s % fT;
    if (!r.hasGlyphForCodePoint(l) || !r.hasGlyphForCodePoint(c) || i !== c5 && !r.hasGlyphForCodePoint(i))
        return t;
    let d = hB(r, l, n.features);
    d.features.ljmo = !0;
    let u = hB(r, c, n.features);
    u.features.vjmo = !0;
    let A = [d, u];
    if (i > c5) {
        let h = hB(r, i, n.features);
        h.features.tjmo = !0,
        A.push(h)
    }
    return e.splice(t, 1, ...A),
    t + A.length - 1
}
function SVe(e, t, r) {
    let n = e[t], a = e[t].codePoints[0], s = pT(a), i = e[t - 1].codePoints[0], l = pT(i), c, d, u, A;
    if (l === mT && s === yz)
        c = i,
        A = n;
    else {
        s === hT ? (d = e[t - 1],
        u = n) : (d = e[t - 2],
        u = e[t - 1],
        A = n);
        let f = d.codePoints[0]
          , p = u.codePoints[0];
        yVe(f) && bVe(p) && (c = V4 + ((f - G7) * fT + (p - V7)) * zS)
    }
    let h = A && A.codePoints[0] || c5;
    if (c != null && (h === c5 || wVe(h))) {
        let f = c + (h - c5);
        if (r.hasGlyphForCodePoint(f)) {
            let p = l === hT ? 3 : 2;
            return e.splice(t - p + 1, p, hB(r, f, n.features)),
            t - p + 1
        }
    }
    return d && (d.features.ljmo = !0),
    u && (u.features.vjmo = !0),
    A && (A.features.tjmo = !0),
    l === mT ? (rfe(e, t - 1, r),
    t + 1) : t
}
function NVe(e) {
    switch (pT(e)) {
    case mT:
    case tfe:

    case hT:

    e.splice(t - i, 0, n)
}

          , i = r.glyphForCodePoint(a).advanceWidth === 0 ? t : t + 1;
        e.splice(i, 0, s),
        t++
    }
    return t
}

                case 1:

                    for (let d of i)
                        if (d.secondGlyph === a.id)
                            return this.applyPositionValue(0, d.value1),
                            this.applyPositionValue(1, d.value2),
                            !0;
                    return !1;
                case 2:
                    let l = this.getClassID(this.glyphIterator.cur.id, r.classDef1)
                      , c = this.getClassID(a.id, r.classDef2);
                    if (l === -1 || c === -1)
                        return !1;
                    var n = r.classRecords.get(l).get(c);
                    return this.applyPositionValue(0, n.value1),
                    this.applyPositionValue(1, n.value2),
                    !0
                }
            }
        case 3:
            {
                let a = this.glyphIterator.peekIndex()
                  , s = this.glyphs[a];
                if (!s)
                    return !1;
                let i = r.entryExitRecords[this.coverageIndex(r.coverage)];
                if (!i || !i.exitAnchor)
                    return !1;
                let l = r.entryExitRecords[this.coverageIndex(r.coverage, s.id)];
                if (!l || !l.entryAnchor)
                    return !1;
                let c = this.getAnchor(l.entryAnchor), d = this.getAnchor(i.exitAnchor), u = this.positions[this.glyphIterator.index], A = this.positions[a], h;
                switch (this.direction) {
                case "ltr":
                    u.xAdvance = d.x + u.xOffset,
                    h = c.x + A.xOffset,
                    A.xAdvance -= h,
                    A.xOffset -= h;
                    break;
                case "rtl":
                    h = d.x + u.xOffset,
                    u.xAdvance -= h,
                    u.xOffset -= h,
                    A.xAdvance = c.x + A.xOffset;
                    break
                }
                return this.glyphIterator.flags.rightToLeft ? (this.glyphIterator.cur.cursiveAttachment = a,
                u.yOffset = c.y - d.y) : (s.cursiveAttachment = this.glyphIterator.index,
                u.yOffset = d.y - c.y),
                !0
            }
        case 4:
            {
                let a = this.coverageIndex(r.markCoverage);
                if (a === -1)
                    return !1;
                let s = this.glyphIterator.index;
                for (; --s >= 0 && (this.glyphs[s].isMark || this.glyphs[s].ligatureComponent > 0); )
                    ;
                if (s < 0)
                    return !1;
                let i = this.coverageIndex(r.baseCoverage, this.glyphs[s].id);
                if (i === -1)
                    return !1;
                let l = r.markArray[a]
                  , c = r.baseArray[i][l.class];
                return this.applyAnchor(l, c, s),
                !0
            }
        case 5:
            {
                let a = this.coverageIndex(r.markCoverage);
                if (a === -1)
                    return !1;
                let s = this.glyphIterator.index;
                for (; --s >= 0 && this.glyphs[s].isMark; )
                    ;
                if (s < 0)
                    return !1;
                let i = this.coverageIndex(r.ligatureCoverage, this.glyphs[s].id);
                if (i === -1)
                    return !1;
                let l = r.ligatureArray[i]
                  , c = this.glyphIterator.cur
                  , d = this.glyphs[s]
                  , u = d.ligatureID && d.ligatureID === c.ligatureID && c.ligatureComponent > 0 ? Math.min(c.ligatureComponent, d.codePoints.length) - 1 : d.codePoints.length - 1
                  , A = r.markArray[a]
                  , h = l[u][A.class];
                return this.applyAnchor(A, h, s),
                !0
            }
        case 6:
            {
                let a = this.coverageIndex(r.mark1Coverage);
                if (a === -1)
                    return !1;
                let s = this.glyphIterator.peekIndex(-1)
                  , i = this.glyphs[s];
                if (!i || !i.isMark)
                    return !1;
                let l = this.glyphIterator.cur
                  , c = !1;
                if (l.ligatureID === i.ligatureID ? l.ligatureID ? l.ligatureComponent === i.ligatureComponent && (c = !0) : c = !0 : (l.ligatureID && !l.ligatureComponent || i.ligatureID && !i.ligatureComponent) && (c = !0),
                !c)
                    return !1;
                let d = this.coverageIndex(r.mark2Coverage, i.id);
                if (d === -1)
                    return !1;
                let u = r.mark1Array[a]
                  , A = r.mark2Array[d][u.class];
                return this.applyAnchor(u, A, s),
                !0
            }
        case 7:
            return this.applyContext(r);
        case 8:
            return this.applyChainingContext(r);
        case 9:
            return this.applyLookup(r.lookupType, r.extension);
        default:
            throw new Error(`Unsupported GPOS table: ${t}`)
        }
    }
    applyAnchor(t, r, n) {
        let a = this.getAnchor(r)
          , s = this.getAnchor(t.markAnchor);
        this.positions[n];
        let i = this.positions[this.glyphIterator.index];
        i.xOffset = a.x - s.x,
        i.yOffset = a.y - s.y,
        this.glyphIterator.cur.markAttachment = n
    }
    getAnchor(t) {
        let r = t.xCoordinate
          , n = t.yCoordinate
          , a = this.font._variationProcessor
          , s = this.font.GDEF && this.font.GDEF.itemVariationStore;
        return a && s && (t.xDeviceTable && (r += a.getDelta(s, t.xDeviceTable.a, t.xDeviceTable.b)),
        t.yDeviceTable && (n += a.getDelta(s, t.yDeviceTable.a, t.yDeviceTable.b))),
        {
            x: r,
            y: n
        }
    }
    applyFeatures(t, r, n) {
        super.applyFeatures(t, r, n);
        for (var a = 0; a < this.glyphs.length; a++)
            this.fixCursiveAttachment(a);
        this.fixMarkAttachment()
    }
    fixCursiveAttachment(t) {
        let r = this.glyphs[t];
        if (r.cursiveAttachment != null) {
            let n = r.cursiveAttachment;
            r.cursiveAttachment = null,
            this.fixCursiveAttachment(n),
            this.positions[t].yOffset += this.positions[n].yOffset
        }
    }
    fixMarkAttachment() {
        for (let t = 0; t < this.glyphs.length; t++) {
            let r = this.glyphs[t];
            if (r.markAttachment != null) {
                let n = r.markAttachment;
                if (this.positions[t].xOffset += this.positions[n].xOffset,
                this.positions[t].yOffset += this.positions[n].yOffset,
                this.direction === "ltr")
                    for (let a = n; a < t; a++)
                        this.positions[t].xOffset -= this.positions[a].xAdvance,
                        this.positions[t].yOffset -= this.positions[a].yAdvance;
                else
                    for (let a = n + 1; a < t + 1; a++)
                        this.positions[t].xOffset += this.positions[a].xAdvance,
                        this.positions[t].yOffset += this.positions[a].yAdvance
            }
        }
    }
}
class JVe {
    setup(t) {
        this.glyphInfos = t.glyphs.map(n => new Qg(this.font,n.id,[...n.codePoints]));
        let r = null;
        this.GPOSProcessor && (r = this.GPOSProcessor.selectScript(t.script, t.language, t.direction)),
        this.GSUBProcessor && (r = this.GSUBProcessor.selectScript(t.script, t.language, t.direction)),
        this.shaper = YVe(r),
        this.plan = new JGe(this.font,r,t.direction),
        this.shaper.plan(this.plan, this.glyphInfos, t.features);
        for (let n in this.plan.allFeatures)
            t.features[n] = !0
    }
    substitute(t) {
        this.GSUBProcessor && (this.plan.process(this.GSUBProcessor, this.glyphInfos),
        t.glyphs = this.glyphInfos.map(r => this.font.getGlyph(r.id, r.codePoints)))
    }
    position(t) {
        return this.shaper.zeroMarkWidths === "BEFORE_GPOS" && this.zeroMarkAdvances(t.positions),
        this.GPOSProcessor && this.plan.process(this.GPOSProcessor, this.glyphInfos, t.positions),
        this.shaper.zeroMarkWidths === "AFTER_GPOS" && this.zeroMarkAdvances(t.positions),
        t.direction === "rtl" && (t.glyphs.reverse(),
        t.positions.reverse()),
        this.GPOSProcessor && this.GPOSProcessor.features
    }
    zeroMarkAdvances(t) {
        for (let r = 0; r < this.glyphInfos.length; r++)
            this.glyphInfos[r].isMark && (t[r].xAdvance = 0,
            t[r].yAdvance = 0)
    }
    cleanup() {
        this.glyphInfos = null,
        this.plan = null,
        this.shaper = null
    }
    getAvailableFeatures(t, r) {
        let n = [];
        return this.GSUBProcessor && (this.GSUBProcessor.selectScript(t, r),
        n.push(...Object.keys(this.GSUBProcessor.features))),
        this.GPOSProcessor && (this.GPOSProcessor.selectScript(t, r),
        n.push(...Object.keys(this.GPOSProcessor.features))),
        n
    }
    constructor(t) {
        this.font = t,
        this.glyphInfos = null,
        this.plan = null,
        this.GSUBProcessor = null,
        this.GPOSProcessor = null,
        this.fallbackPosition = !0,
        t.GSUB && (this.GSUBProcessor = new XVe(t,t.GSUB)),
        t.GPOS && (this.GPOSProcessor = new qVe(t,t.GPOS))
    }
}
class ZVe {
    layout(t, r, n, a, s) {
        if (typeof r == "string" && (s = a,
        a = n,
        n = r,
        r = []),
        typeof t == "string") {
            n == null && (n = SGe(t));
            var i = this.font.glyphsForString(t)
        } else {
            if (n == null) {
                let d = [];
                for (let u of t)
                    d.push(...u.codePoints);
                n = NGe(d)
            }
            var i = t
        }
        let l = new FGe(i,r,n,a,s);
        return i.length === 0 ? (l.positions = [],
        l) : (this.engine && this.engine.setup && this.engine.setup(l),
        this.substitute(l),
        this.position(l),
        this.hideDefaultIgnorables(l.glyphs, l.positions),
        this.engine && this.engine.cleanup && this.engine.cleanup(),
        l)
    }
    substitute(t) {
        this.engine && this.engine.substitute && this.engine.substitute(t)
    }
    position(t) {
        t.positions = t.glyphs.map(n => new TGe(n.advanceWidth));
        let r = null;
        this.engine && this.engine.position && (r = this.engine.position(t)),
        !r && (!this.engine || this.engine.fallbackPosition) && (this.unicodeLayoutEngine || (this.unicodeLayoutEngine = new IGe(this.font)),
        this.unicodeLayoutEngine.positionGlyphs(t.glyphs, t.positions)),
        (!r || !r.kern) && t.features.kern !== !1 && this.font.kern && (this.kernProcessor || (this.kernProcessor = new EGe(this.font)),
        this.kernProcessor.process(t.glyphs, t.positions),
        t.features.kern = !0)
    }
    hideDefaultIgnorables(t, r) {
        let n = this.font.glyphForCodePoint(32);
        for (let a = 0; a < t.length; a++)
            this.isDefaultIgnorable(t[a].codePoints[0]) && (t[a] = n,
            r[a].xAdvance = 0,
            r[a].yAdvance = 0)
    }
    isDefaultIgnorable(t) {
        let r = t >> 16;
        if (r === 0)
            switch (t >> 8) {
            case 0:
                return t === 173;
            case 3:
                return t === 847;
            case 6:
                return t === 1564;
            case 23:
                return 6068 <= t && t <= 6069;
            case 24:
                return 6155 <= t && t <= 6158;
            case 32:
                return 8203 <= t && t <= 8207 || 8234 <= t && t <= 8238 || 8288 <= t && t <= 8303;
            case 254:
                return 65024 <= t && t <= 65039 || t === 65279;
            case 255:
                return 65520 <= t && t <= 65528;
            default:
                return !1
            }
        else
            switch (r) {
            case 1:
                return 113824 <= t && t <= 113827 || 119155 <= t && t <= 119162;
            case 14:
                return 917504 <= t && t <= 921599;
            default:
                return !1
            }
    }
    getAvailableFeatures(t, r) {
        let n = [];
        return this.engine && n.push(...this.engine.getAvailableFeatures(t, r)),
        this.font.kern && n.indexOf("kern") === -1 && n.push("kern"),
        n
    }
    stringsForGlyph(t) {
        let r = new Set
          , n = this.font._cmapProcessor.codePointsForGlyph(t);
        for (let a of n)
            r.add(String.fromCodePoint(a));
        if (this.engine && this.engine.stringsForGlyph)
            for (let a of this.engine.stringsForGlyph(t))
                r.add(a);
        return Array.from(r)
    }
    constructor(t) {
        this.font = t,
        this.unicodeLayoutEngine = null,
        this.kernProcessor = null,
        this.font.morx ? this.engine = new qGe(this.font) : (this.font.GSUB || this.font.GPOS) && (this.engine = new JVe(this.font))
    }
}

    moveTo: "M",

class FE {
    toFunction() {
        return t => {
            this.commands.forEach(r => t[r.command].apply(t, r.args))
        }
    }
    toSVG() {
        return this.commands.map(r => {
            let n = r.args.map(a => Math.round(a * 100) / 100);
            return `${$Ve[r.command]}${n.join(" ")}`
        }
        ).join("")
    }
    get cbox() {
        if (!this._cbox) {
            let t = new Fy;
            for (let r of this.commands)
                for (let n = 0; n < r.args.length; n += 2)
                    t.addPoint(r.args[n], r.args[n + 1]);
            this._cbox = Object.freeze(t)
        }
        return this._cbox
    }
    get bbox() {
        if (this._bbox)
            return this._bbox;
        let t = new Fy
          , r = 0
          , n = 0
          , a = x => Math.pow(1 - x, 3) * f[g] + 3 * Math.pow(1 - x, 2) * x * p[g] + 3 * (1 - x) * Math.pow(x, 2) * m[g] + Math.pow(x, 3) * v[g];
        for (let x of this.commands)
            switch (x.command) {
            case "moveTo":
            case "lineTo":
                let[y,b] = x.args;
                t.addPoint(y, b),
                r = y,
                n = b;
                break;
            case "quadraticCurveTo":
            case "bezierCurveTo":
                if (x.command === "quadraticCurveTo")
                    var [s,i,A,h] = x.args
                      , l = r + 2 / 3 * (s - r)
                      , c = n + 2 / 3 * (i - n)
                      , d = A + 2 / 3 * (s - A)
                      , u = h + 2 / 3 * (i - h);
                else
                    var [l,c,d,u,A,h] = x.args;
                t.addPoint(A, h);
                for (var f = [r, n], p = [l, c], m = [d, u], v = [A, h], g = 0; g <= 1; g++) {
                    let w = 6 * f[g] - 12 * p[g] + 6 * m[g]
                      , F = -3 * f[g] + 9 * p[g] - 9 * m[g] + 3 * v[g];
                    if (x = 3 * p[g] - 3 * f[g],
                    F === 0) {
                        if (w === 0)
                            continue;
                        let P = -x / w;
                        0 < P && P < 1 && (g === 0 ? t.addPoint(a(P), t.maxY) : g === 1 && t.addPoint(t.maxX, a(P)));
                        continue
                    }
                    let N = Math.pow(w, 2) - 4 * x * F;
                    if (N < 0)
                        continue;
                    let j = (-w + Math.sqrt(N)) / (2 * F);
                    0 < j && j < 1 && (g === 0 ? t.addPoint(a(j), t.maxY) : g === 1 && t.addPoint(t.maxX, a(j)));
                    let k = (-w - Math.sqrt(N)) / (2 * F);
                    0 < k && k < 1 && (g === 0 ? t.addPoint(a(k), t.maxY) : g === 1 && t.addPoint(t.maxX, a(k)))
                }
                r = A,
                n = h;
                break
            }
        return this._bbox = Object.freeze(t)
    }
    mapPoints(t) {
        let r = new FE;
        for (let n of this.commands) {
            let a = [];
            for (let s = 0; s < n.args.length; s += 2) {
                let[i,l] = t(n.args[s], n.args[s + 1]);
                a.push(i, l)
            }
            r[n.command](...a)
        }
        return r
    }
    transform(t, r, n, a, s, i) {
        return this.mapPoints( (l, c) => {
            const d = t * l + n * c + s
              , u = r * l + a * c + i;
            return [d, u]
        }
        )
    }
    translate(t, r) {
        return this.transform(1, 0, 0, 1, t, r)
    }
    rotate(t) {
        let r = Math.cos(t)
          , n = Math.sin(t);
        return this.transform(r, n, -n, r, 0, 0)
    }
    scale(t, r=t) {
        return this.transform(t, 0, 0, r, 0, 0)
    }
    constructor() {
        this.commands = [],
        this._bbox = null,
        this._cbox = null
    }
}

        this.commands.push({

    _getTableMetrics(t) {
        if (this.id < t.metrics.length)
            return t.metrics.get(this.id);
        let r = t.metrics.get(t.metrics.length - 1);
        return {
            advance: r ? r.advance : 0,
            bearing: t.bearings.get(this.id - t.metrics.length) || 0
        }
    }
    _getMetrics(t) {
        if (this._metrics)
            return this._metrics;
        let {advance: r, bearing: n} = this._getTableMetrics(this._font.hmtx);
        if (this._font.vmtx)
            var {advance: a, bearing: s} = this._getTableMetrics(this._font.vmtx);
        else {
            let i;
            if ((typeof t > "u" || t === null) && ({cbox: t} = this),
            (i = this._font["OS/2"]) && i.version > 0)
                var a = Math.abs(i.typoAscender - i.typoDescender)
                  , s = i.typoAscender - t.maxY;
            else {

                  , s = l.ascent - t.maxY
            }

        }

        }

const eWe = 1
  , tWe = 2
  , rWe = 4
  , nWe = 8
  , aWe = 16
  , sWe = 32
  , iWe = 1
  , oWe = 8
  , VJ = 32
  , lWe = 64
  , cWe = 128
  , uWe = 256;
class og {

    }
    constructor(t, r, n=0, a=0) {
        this.onCurve = t,
        this.endContour = r,

        this.y = a
    }

class dWe {
    constructor(t, r, n) {

class K7 extends Z1 {
    _getCBox(t) {
        if (this._font._variationProcessor && !t)
            return this.path.cbox;
        let r = this._font._getTableStream("glyf");
        r.pos += this._font.loca.offsets[this.id];
        let n = GJ.decode(r)
          , a = new Fy(n.xMin,n.yMin,n.xMax,n.yMax);
        return Object.freeze(a)
    }
    _parseGlyphCoord(t, r, n, a) {
        if (n) {
            var s = t.readUInt8();
            a || (s = -s),
            s += r
        } else if (a)
            var s = r;
        else
            var s = r + t.readInt16BE();
        return s
    }
    _decode() {
        let t = this._font.loca.offsets[this.id]
          , r = this._font.loca.offsets[this.id + 1];
        if (t === r)
            return null;
        let n = this._font._getTableStream("glyf");
        n.pos += t;
        let a = n.pos
          , s = GJ.decode(n);
        return s.numberOfContours > 0 ? this._decodeSimple(s, n) : s.numberOfContours < 0 && this._decodeComposite(s, n, a),
        s
    }
    _decodeSimple(t, r) {
        t.points = [];
        let n = new Wt(ge,t.numberOfContours).decode(r);
        t.instructions = new Wt(fn,ge).decode(r);
        let a = []
          , s = n[n.length - 1] + 1;
        for (; a.length < s; ) {
            var i = r.readUInt8();
            if (a.push(i),
            i & nWe) {
                let u = r.readUInt8();
                for (let A = 0; A < u; A++)
                    a.push(i)
            }
        }
        for (var l = 0; l < a.length; l++) {
            var i = a[l];
            let A = new og(!!(i & eWe),n.indexOf(l) >= 0,0,0);
            t.points.push(A)
        }
        let c = 0;
        for (var l = 0; l < a.length; l++) {
            var i = a[l];
            t.points[l].x = c = this._parseGlyphCoord(r, c, i & tWe, i & aWe)
        }
        let d = 0;
        for (var l = 0; l < a.length; l++) {
            var i = a[l];
            t.points[l].y = d = this._parseGlyphCoord(r, d, i & rWe, i & sWe)
        }
        if (this._font._variationProcessor) {
            let u = t.points.slice();
            u.push(...this._getPhantomPoints(t)),
            this._font._variationProcessor.transformPoints(this.id, u),
            t.phantomPoints = u.slice(-4)
        }
    }
    _decodeComposite(t, r, n=0) {
        t.components = [];
        let a = !1
          , s = VJ;
        for (; s & VJ; ) {
            s = r.readUInt16BE();
            let d = r.pos - n
              , u = r.readUInt16BE();
            if (a || (a = (s & uWe) !== 0),
            s & iWe)
                var i = r.readInt16BE()
                  , l = r.readInt16BE();
            else
                var i = r.readInt8()
                  , l = r.readInt8();
            var c = new dWe(u,i,l);
            c.pos = d,
            s & oWe ? c.scaleX = c.scaleY = (r.readUInt8() << 24 | r.readUInt8() << 16) / 1073741824 : s & lWe ? (c.scaleX = (r.readUInt8() << 24 | r.readUInt8() << 16) / 1073741824,
            c.scaleY = (r.readUInt8() << 24 | r.readUInt8() << 16) / 1073741824) : s & cWe && (c.scaleX = (r.readUInt8() << 24 | r.readUInt8() << 16) / 1073741824,
            c.scale01 = (r.readUInt8() << 24 | r.readUInt8() << 16) / 1073741824,
            c.scale10 = (r.readUInt8() << 24 | r.readUInt8() << 16) / 1073741824,
            c.scaleY = (r.readUInt8() << 24 | r.readUInt8() << 16) / 1073741824),
            t.components.push(c)
        }
        if (this._font._variationProcessor) {
            let d = [];
            for (let u = 0; u < t.components.length; u++) {
                var c = t.components[u];
                d.push(new og(!0,!0,c.dx,c.dy))
            }
            d.push(...this._getPhantomPoints(t)),
            this._font._variationProcessor.transformPoints(this.id, d),
            t.phantomPoints = d.splice(-4, 4);
            for (let u = 0; u < d.length; u++) {
                let A = d[u];
                t.components[u].dx = A.x,
                t.components[u].dy = A.y
            }
        }
        return a
    }
    _getPhantomPoints(t) {
        let r = this._getCBox(!0);
        this._metrics == null && (this._metrics = Z1.prototype._getMetrics.call(this, r));
        let {advanceWidth: n, advanceHeight: a, leftBearing: s, topBearing: i} = this._metrics;
        return [new og(!1,!0,t.xMin - s,0), new og(!1,!0,t.xMin - s + n,0), new og(!1,!0,0,t.yMax + i), new og(!1,!0,0,t.yMax + i + a)]
    }
    _getContours() {
        let t = this._decode();
        if (!t)
            return [];
        let r = [];
        if (t.numberOfContours < 0)
            for (let i of t.components) {
                let l = this._font.getGlyph(i.glyphID)._getContours();
                for (let c = 0; c < l.length; c++) {
                    let d = l[c];
                    for (let u = 0; u < d.length; u++) {
                        let A = d[u]
                          , h = A.x * i.scaleX + A.y * i.scale01 + i.dx
                          , f = A.y * i.scaleY + A.x * i.scale10 + i.dy;
                        r.push(new og(A.onCurve,A.endContour,h,f))
                    }
                }
            }
        else
            r = t.points || [];
        t.phantomPoints && !this._font.directory.tables.HVAR && (this._metrics.advanceWidth = t.phantomPoints[1].x - t.phantomPoints[0].x,
        this._metrics.advanceHeight = t.phantomPoints[3].y - t.phantomPoints[2].y,
        this._metrics.leftBearing = t.xMin - t.phantomPoints[0].x,
        this._metrics.topBearing = t.phantomPoints[2].y - t.yMax);
        let n = []
          , a = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {
            var s = r[i];
            a.push(s),
            s.endContour && (n.push(a),
            a = [])
        }
        return n
    }
    _getMetrics() {
        if (this._metrics)
            return this._metrics;
        let t = this._getCBox(!0);
        return super._getMetrics(t),
        this._font._variationProcessor && !this._font.HVAR && this.path,
        this._metrics
    }
    _getPath() {
        let t = this._getContours()
          , r = new FE;
        for (let a = 0; a < t.length; a++) {
            let s = t[a]
              , i = s[0]
              , l = s[s.length - 1]
              , c = 0;
            if (i.onCurve) {
                var n = null;
                c = 1
            } else {
                l.onCurve ? i = l : i = new og(!1,!1,(i.x + l.x) / 2,(i.y + l.y) / 2);
                var n = i
            }
            r.moveTo(i.x, i.y);
            for (let d = c; d < s.length; d++) {
                let u = s[d]
                  , A = d === 0 ? i : s[d - 1];
                if (A.onCurve && u.onCurve)
                    r.lineTo(u.x, u.y);
                else if (A.onCurve && !u.onCurve)
                    var n = u;
                else if (!A.onCurve && !u.onCurve) {
                    let f = (A.x + u.x) / 2
                      , p = (A.y + u.y) / 2;
                    r.quadraticCurveTo(A.x, A.y, f, p);
                    var n = u
                } else if (!A.onCurve && u.onCurve) {
                    r.quadraticCurveTo(n.x, n.y, u.x, u.y);
                    var n = null
                } else
                    throw new Error("Unknown TTF path state")
            }
            n && r.quadraticCurveTo(n.x, n.y, i.x, i.y),
            r.closePath()
        }
        return r
    }
    constructor(...t) {
        super(...t),
        Xh(this, "type", "TTF")
    }
}

class hWe extends K7 {
    getImageForSize(t) {
        for (let i = 0; i < this._font.sbix.imageTables.length; i++) {
            var r = this._font.sbix.imageTables[i];
            if (r.ppem >= t)
                break
        }
        let n = r.imageOffsets
          , a = n[this.id]
          , s = n[this.id + 1];
        return a === s ? null : (this._font.stream.pos = a,
        fWe.decode(this._font.stream, {
            buflen: s - a
        }))
    }
    render(t, r) {
        let n = this.getImageForSize(r);
        if (n != null) {
            let a = r / this._font.unitsPerEm;
            t.image(n.data, {
                height: r,
                x: n.originX,
                y: (this.bbox.minY - n.originY) * a
            })
        }
        this._font.sbix.flags.renderOutlines && super.render(t, r)
    }
    constructor(...t) {
        super(...t),
        Xh(this, "type", "SBIX")
    }
}

const pWe = 32768
  , gWe = 4095
  , vWe = 32768
  , KJ = 16384
  , xWe = 8192
  , YJ = 4095
  , XJ = 128
  , qJ = 127
  , yWe = 128
  , bWe = 64
  , wWe = 63;
class CWe {
    normalizeCoords(t) {
        let r = [];
        for (var n = 0; n < this.font.fvar.axis.length; n++) {
            let a = this.font.fvar.axis[n];
            t[n] < a.defaultValue ? r.push((t[n] - a.defaultValue + Number.EPSILON) / (a.defaultValue - a.minValue + Number.EPSILON)) : r.push((t[n] - a.defaultValue + Number.EPSILON) / (a.maxValue - a.defaultValue + Number.EPSILON))
        }
        if (this.font.avar)
            for (var n = 0; n < this.font.avar.segment.length; n++) {
                let s = this.font.avar.segment[n];
                for (let i = 0; i < s.correspondence.length; i++) {
                    let l = s.correspondence[i];
                    if (i >= 1 && r[n] < l.fromCoord) {
                        let c = s.correspondence[i - 1];
                        r[n] = ((r[n] - c.fromCoord) * (l.toCoord - c.toCoord) + Number.EPSILON) / (l.fromCoord - c.fromCoord + Number.EPSILON) + c.toCoord;
                        break
                    }
                }
            }
        return r
    }
    transformPoints(t, r) {
        if (!this.font.fvar || !this.font.gvar)
            return;
        let {gvar: n} = this.font;
        if (t >= n.glyphCount)
            return;
        let a = n.offsets[t];
        if (a === n.offsets[t + 1])
            return;
        let {stream: s} = this.font;
        if (s.pos = a,
        s.pos >= s.length)
            return;
        let i = s.readUInt16BE()
          , l = a + s.readUInt16BE();
        if (i & pWe) {
            var c = s.pos;
            s.pos = l;
            var d = this.decodePoints();
            l = s.pos,
            s.pos = c
        }
        let u = r.map(v => v.copy());
        i &= gWe;
        for (let v = 0; v < i; v++) {
            let g = s.readUInt16BE()
              , x = s.readUInt16BE();
            if (x & vWe) {
                var A = [];
                for (let j = 0; j < n.axisCount; j++)
                    A.push(s.readInt16BE() / 16384)
            } else {
                if ((x & YJ) >= n.globalCoordCount)
                    throw new Error("Invalid gvar table");
                var A = n.globalCoords[x & YJ]
            }
            if (x & KJ) {
                var h = [];
                for (let j = 0; j < n.axisCount; j++)
                    h.push(s.readInt16BE() / 16384);
                var f = [];
                for (let j = 0; j < n.axisCount; j++)
                    f.push(s.readInt16BE() / 16384)
            }
            let y = this.tupleFactor(x, A, h, f);
            if (y === 0) {
                l += g;
                continue
            }
            var c = s.pos;
            if (s.pos = l,
            x & xWe)
                var p = this.decodePoints();
            else
                var p = d;
            let w = p.length === 0 ? r.length : p.length
              , F = this.decodeDeltas(w)
              , N = this.decodeDeltas(w);
            if (p.length === 0)
                for (let j = 0; j < r.length; j++) {
                    var m = r[j];
                    m.x += Math.round(F[j] * y),
                    m.y += Math.round(N[j] * y)
                }
            else {
                let j = u.map(P => P.copy())
                  , k = r.map( () => !1);
                for (let P = 0; P < p.length; P++) {
                    let Q = p[P];
                    if (Q < r.length) {
                        let B = j[Q];
                        k[Q] = !0,
                        B.x += F[P] * y,
                        B.y += N[P] * y
                    }
                }
                this.interpolateMissingDeltas(j, u, k);
                for (let P = 0; P < r.length; P++) {
                    let Q = j[P].x - u[P].x
                      , B = j[P].y - u[P].y;
                    r[P].x = Math.round(r[P].x + Q),
                    r[P].y = Math.round(r[P].y + B)
                }
            }
            l += g,
            s.pos = c
        }
    }
    decodePoints() {
        let t = this.font.stream
          , r = t.readUInt8();
        r & XJ && (r = (r & qJ) << 8 | t.readUInt8());
        let n = new Uint16Array(r)
          , a = 0
          , s = 0;
        for (; a < r; ) {
            let i = t.readUInt8()
              , l = (i & qJ) + 1
              , c = i & XJ ? t.readUInt16 : t.readUInt8;
            for (let d = 0; d < l && a < r; d++)
                s += c.call(t),
                n[a++] = s
        }
        return n
    }
    decodeDeltas(t) {
        let r = this.font.stream
          , n = 0
          , a = new Int16Array(t);
        for (; n < t; ) {
            let s = r.readUInt8()
              , i = (s & wWe) + 1;
            if (s & yWe)
                n += i;
            else {
                let l = s & bWe ? r.readInt16BE : r.readInt8;
                for (let c = 0; c < i && n < t; c++)
                    a[n++] = l.call(r)
            }
        }
        return a
    }
    tupleFactor(t, r, n, a) {
        let s = this.normalizedCoords
          , {gvar: i} = this.font
          , l = 1;
        for (let c = 0; c < i.axisCount; c++)
            if (r[c] !== 0) {
                if (s[c] === 0)
                    return 0;
                if (t & KJ) {
                    if (s[c] < n[c] || s[c] > a[c])
                        return 0;
                    s[c] < r[c] ? l = l * (s[c] - n[c] + Number.EPSILON) / (r[c] - n[c] + Number.EPSILON) : l = l * (a[c] - s[c] + Number.EPSILON) / (a[c] - r[c] + Number.EPSILON)
                } else {
                    if (s[c] < Math.min(0, r[c]) || s[c] > Math.max(0, r[c]))
                        return 0;
                    l = (l * s[c] + Number.EPSILON) / (r[c] + Number.EPSILON)
                }
            }
        return l
    }
    interpolateMissingDeltas(t, r, n) {
        if (t.length === 0)
            return;
        let a = 0;
        for (; a < t.length; ) {
            let s = a
              , i = a
              , l = t[i];
            for (; !l.endContour; )
                l = t[++i];
            for (; a <= i && !n[a]; )
                a++;
            if (a > i)
                continue;
            let c = a
              , d = a;
            for (a++; a <= i; )
                n[a] && (this.deltaInterpolate(d + 1, a - 1, d, a, r, t),
                d = a),
                a++;
            d === c ? this.deltaShift(s, i, d, r, t) : (this.deltaInterpolate(d + 1, i, d, c, r, t),
            c > 0 && this.deltaInterpolate(s, c - 1, d, c, r, t)),
            a = i + 1
        }
    }
    deltaInterpolate(t, r, n, a, s, i) {
        if (t > r)
            return;
        let l = ["x", "y"];
        for (let d = 0; d < l.length; d++) {
            let u = l[d];
            if (s[n][u] > s[a][u]) {
                var c = n;
                n = a,
                a = c
            }
            let A = s[n][u]
              , h = s[a][u]
              , f = i[n][u]
              , p = i[a][u];
            if (A !== h || f === p) {
                let m = A === h ? 0 : (p - f) / (h - A);
                for (let v = t; v <= r; v++) {
                    let g = s[v][u];
                    g <= A ? g += f - A : g >= h ? g += p - h : g = f + (g - A) * m,
                    i[v][u] = g
                }
            }
        }
    }
    deltaShift(t, r, n, a, s) {
        let i = s[n].x - a[n].x
          , l = s[n].y - a[n].y;
        if (!(i === 0 && l === 0))
            for (let c = t; c <= r; c++)
                c !== n && (s[c].x += i,
                s[c].y += l)
    }
    getAdvanceAdjustment(t, r) {
        let n, a;
        if (r.advanceWidthMapping) {
            let s = t;
            s >= r.advanceWidthMapping.mapCount && (s = r.advanceWidthMapping.mapCount - 1),
            r.advanceWidthMapping.entryFormat,
            {outerIndex: n, innerIndex: a} = r.advanceWidthMapping.mapData[s]
        } else
            n = 0,
            a = t;
        return this.getDelta(r.itemVariationStore, n, a)
    }
    getDelta(t, r, n) {
        if (r >= t.itemVariationData.length)
            return 0;
        let a = t.itemVariationData[r];
        if (n >= a.deltaSets.length)
            return 0;
        let s = a.deltaSets[n]
          , i = this.getBlendVector(t, r)
          , l = 0;
        for (let c = 0; c < a.regionIndexCount; c++)
            l += s.deltas[c] * i[c];
        return l
    }
    getBlendVector(t, r) {
        let n = t.itemVariationData[r];
        if (this.blendVectors.has(n))
            return this.blendVectors.get(n);
        let a = this.normalizedCoords
          , s = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < n.regionIndexCount; i++) {
            let l = 1
              , c = n.regionIndexes[i]
              , d = t.variationRegionList.variationRegions[c];
            for (let u = 0; u < d.length; u++) {
                let A = d[u], h;
                A.startCoord > A.peakCoord || A.peakCoord > A.endCoord || A.startCoord < 0 && A.endCoord > 0 && A.peakCoord !== 0 || A.peakCoord === 0 ? h = 1 : a[u] < A.startCoord || a[u] > A.endCoord ? h = 0 : a[u] === A.peakCoord ? h = 1 : a[u] < A.peakCoord ? h = (a[u] - A.startCoord + Number.EPSILON) / (A.peakCoord - A.startCoord + Number.EPSILON) : h = (A.endCoord - a[u] + Number.EPSILON) / (A.endCoord - A.peakCoord + Number.EPSILON),
                l *= h
            }
            s[i] = l
        }
        return this.blendVectors.set(n, s),
        s
    }
    constructor(t, r) {
        this.font = t,
        this.normalizedCoords = this.normalizeCoords(r),
        this.blendVectors = new Map
    }
}

class FWe {
    encodeSimple(t, r=[]) {
        let n = []
          , a = []
          , s = []
          , i = []
          , l = 0
          , c = 0
          , d = 0
          , u = 0
          , A = 0;
        for (let g = 0; g < t.commands.length; g++) {
            let x = t.commands[g];
            for (let y = 0; y < x.args.length; y += 2) {
                let b = x.args[y]
                  , w = x.args[y + 1]
                  , F = 0;
                if (x.command === "quadraticCurveTo" && y === 2) {
                    let N = t.commands[g + 1];
                    if (N && N.command === "quadraticCurveTo") {
                        let j = (c + N.args[0]) / 2
                          , k = (d + N.args[1]) / 2;
                        if (b === j && w === k)
                            continue
                    }
                }
                x.command === "quadraticCurveTo" && y === 0 || (F |= EWe),
                F = this._encodePoint(b, c, a, F, IWe, NWe),
                F = this._encodePoint(w, d, s, F, BWe, jWe),
                F === u && l < 255 ? (i[i.length - 1] |= SWe,
                l++) : (l > 0 && (i.push(l),
                l = 0),
                i.push(F),
                u = F),
                c = b,
                d = w,
                A++
            }
            x.command === "closePath" && n.push(A - 1)
        }
        t.commands.length > 1 && t.commands[t.commands.length - 1].command !== "closePath" && n.push(A - 1);
        let h = t.bbox
          , f = {
            numberOfContours: n.length,
            xMin: h.minX,
            yMin: h.minY,
            xMax: h.maxX,
            yMax: h.maxY,
            endPtsOfContours: n,
            instructions: r,
            flags: i,
            xPoints: a,
            yPoints: s
        }
          , p = ZJ.size(f)
          , m = 4 - p % 4
          , v = new nT(p + m);
        return ZJ.encode(v, f),
        m !== 0 && v.fill(0, m),
        v.buffer
    }
    _encodePoint(t, r, n, a, s, i) {
        let l = t - r;
        return t === r ? a |= i : (-255 <= l && l <= 255 && (a |= s,
        l < 0 ? l = -l : a |= i),
        n.push(l)),
        a
    }
}

class kWe extends ofe {

    }
    subsetSubrs(t, r) {

        for (let a = 0; a < t.length; a++) {
            let s = t[a];
            r[a] ? (this.cff.stream.pos = s.offset,
            n.push(this.cff.stream.readBuffer(s.length))) : n.push(new Uint8Array([11]))
        }
        return n
    }
    subsetFontdict(t) {

        t.FDSelect = {
            version: 0,
            fds: []
        };
        let r = {}
          , n = []
          , a = {};

            if (i == null)

            r[i] || (t.FDArray.push(Object.assign({}, this.cff.topDict.FDArray[i])),

            r[i] = !0,
            t.FDSelect.fds.push(a[i]);
            let l = this.font.getGlyph(s);
            l.path;
            for (let c in l._usedSubrs)
                n[a[i]][c] = !0
        }

            i.Private && i.Private.Subrs && (i.Private = Object.assign({}, i.Private),
            i.Private.Subrs = this.subsetSubrs(i.Private.Subrs, n[s]))
        }
    }
    createCIDFontdict(t) {

            let s = this.font.getGlyph(a);
            s.path;
            for (let i in s._usedSubrs)
                r[i] = !0
        }

        return this.cff.topDict.Private && this.cff.topDict.Private.Subrs && (n.Subrs = this.subsetSubrs(this.cff.topDict.Private.Subrs, r)),
        t.FDArray = [{
            Private: n
        }],

            version: 3,
            nRanges: 1,
            ranges: [{
                first: 0,
                fd: 0
            }],
            sentinel: this.charstrings.length
        }
    }

        return t ? (this.strings || (this.strings = []),
        this.strings.push(t),
        I8.length + this.strings.length - 1) : null
    }
    encode() {
        this.subsetCharstrings();
        let t = {

                first: 1,

            }]
        }

        r.Encoding = null,

        for (let a of ["version", "Notice", "Copyright", "FullName", "FamilyName", "Weight", "PostScript", "BaseFontName", "FontName"])
            r[a] = this.addString(this.cff.string(r[a]));
        r.ROS = [this.addString("Adobe"), this.addString("Identity"), 0],
        r.CIDCount = this.charstrings.length,

        let n = {
            version: 1,
            hdrSize: this.cff.hdrSize,
            offSize: 4,
            header: this.cff.header,
            nameIndex: [this.cff.postscriptName],
            topDictIndex: [r],
            stringIndex: this.strings,

        };

    }
    constructor(t) {
        if (super(t),
        this.cff = this.font["CFF "],
        !this.cff)

    }

function oet(e) {
    const t = {
        attributes: {},
        glyphWidths: {},
        kernPairs: {}
    };
    let r = "";
    for (let c of e.split(`
`)) {
        var n, a;
        if (n = c.match(/^Start(\w+)/)) {
            r = n[1];
            continue
        } else if (n = c.match(/^End(\w+)/)) {
            r = "";
            continue
        }
        switch (r) {
        case "FontMetrics":
            n = c.match(/(^\w+)\s+(.*)/);
            var s = n[1]
              , i = n[2];
            (a = t.attributes[s]) ? (Array.isArray(a) || (a = t.attributes[s] = [a]),
            a.push(i)) : t.attributes[s] = i;
            break;
        case "CharMetrics":
            if (!/^CH?\s/.test(c))
                continue;
            var l = c.match(/\bN\s+(\.?\w+)\s*;/)[1];
            t.glyphWidths[l] = +c.match(/\bWX\s+(\d+)\s*;/)[1];
            break;
        case "KernPairs":
            n = c.match(/^KPX\s+(\.?\w+)\s+(\.?\w+)\s+(-?\d+)/),
            n && (t.kernPairs[n[1] + n[2]] = parseInt(n[3]));
            break
        }
    }
    return t
}

class H8 {
    constructor() {
        ln(this, "head");
        ln(this, "tail");
        ln(this, "listSize");
        ln(this, "listLength");
        this.head = null,
        this.tail = null,
        this.listSize = 0,
        this.listLength = 0
    }
    isLinked(t) {
        return !(t && t.prev === null && t.next === null && this.tail !== t && this.head !== t || this.isEmpty())
    }
    size() {
        return this.listSize
    }
    isEmpty() {
        return this.listSize === 0
    }
    first() {
        return this.head
    }
    last() {
        return this.last
    }
    forEach(t) {
        let r = this.head;
        for (; r !== null; )
            t(r),
            r = r.next
    }
    at(t) {
        let r = this.head
          , n = 0;
        if (t >= this.listLength || t < 0)
            return null;
        for (; r !== null; ) {
            if (t === n)
                return r;
            r = r.next,
            n += 1
        }
        return null
    }
    insertAfter(t, r) {
        return this.isLinked(t) ? (r.prev = t,
        r.next = t.next,
        t.next === null ? this.tail = r : t.next.prev = r,
        t.next = r,
        this.listSize += 1,
        this) : this
    }
    insertBefore(t, r) {
        return this.isLinked(t) ? (r.prev = t.prev,
        r.next = t,
        t.prev === null ? this.head = r : t.prev.next = r,
        t.prev = r,
        this.listSize += 1,
        this) : this
    }
    push(t) {
        return this.head === null ? this.unshift(t) : this.insertAfter(this.tail, t),
        this
    }
    unshift(t) {
        return this.head === null ? (this.head = t,
        this.tail = t,
        t.prev = null,
        t.next = null,
        this.listSize += 1) : this.insertBefore(this.head, t),
        this
    }
    remove(t) {
        return this.isLinked(t) ? (t.prev === null ? this.head = t.next : t.prev.next = t.next,
        t.next === null ? this.tail = t.prev : t.next.prev = t.prev,
        this.listSize -= 1,
        this) : this
    }
}

function bot(e, t, r, n, a, s) {
